coverage.scope: Selected historical experiments plus latest A/Normal, B/Normal, monthly recursion, weekly and downstream. Canonical cumulative receipts deduplicated.
omissions: Not all historical exploratory model, news-labeling, and source-classification API calls have been reconciled into this index.
Provider invoices and credits were not independently reconciled; API-reported costs and token-usage estimates are kept in separate fields.
The full-A T0 generation and offline evaluation are complete; canonical generation and evaluation manifests are fingerprinted separately.
Some archived experiments have only a combined charged-or-reserved figure or cumulative wrapper receipts; such amounts are not split or added to the reported-API subtotal.
coverage.cost_interpretation: The selected-record summary is a lower-coverage ledger view. API-reported spend, unknown-fee reserve, token-usage estimates, and inseparable charged-or-reserved amounts are never added into one purported project total.

counting_rules.logical_person_months: Unique sampled person-month units, independent of conditions and repeats.
counting_rules.condition_person_months: Person-month units multiplied by experimental arms; not a count of distinct people.
counting_rules.physical_requests: Actual new main and repair API attempts recorded by canonical receipts. Cached historical outputs count as reuse slots, not new physical requests or new spend.
counting_rules.cumulative_receipts: Only the named canonical final receipt contributes billing. Superseded wrappers are fingerprinted as lineage evidence only.
counting_rules.nested_main_repair_receipt: When one canonical JSON contains main and repair layers, sum the two disjoint layers once; do not also add the wrapper main receipt or worker receipt.
counting_rules.unknown_fee_reserve: Reported separately from API-reported spend. A derived reserve is spent-or-reserved minus the same charge group's reported API amount.
counting_rules.token_usage_estimate: A locally computed usage-based estimate, not an invoice or vendor-reported charge.
counting_rules.snapshot: In-progress snapshots are visible as-of their source timestamp but excluded from completed experiment cost subtotals.
counting_rules.full_a_historical_import_cost: For full-A T0, imported historical rows are recorded with zero api_reported_cost_usd and zero request reservation in the new run. historical_source_reported_cost_usd is provenance only; the old source charge remains in its original charge group and is not added or subtracted again.
counting_rules.full_a_final_overlay: Main and repair response counts describe attempts; final unique field coverage comes from the logical overlay receipt. A field using frozen initial input remains explicitly counted as fallback.
